title: Fake bedrock
body:
# ⛏️ Fake Bedrock: Break the Unbreakable

Have you ever found yourself trapped in the Nether roof, unable to break through that pesky bedrock ceiling? Or maybe you're a builder who needs to reshape the very foundation of the world? 

This mod makes the **unbreakable bedrock** breakable, giving you complete control over your Minecraft world. No more getting stuck in the Nether roof - now you can carve your own path through the lowest layers of existence!

Since this is a **simple utility mod**, it focuses on doing one thing well without adding unnecessary complexity. It works perfectly with the Flat Bedrock mod for those who want a cleaner underground experience.

---

## ⭐ Core Features

This mod doesn't add any new blocks or items - it simply modifies the existing bedrock behavior to make it more flexible:

### 🔨 Breakable Bedrock
The unbreakable becomes breakable! You can now mine bedrock just like any other block:
- **Mine with anything** - Any pickaxe works, and you can even break it with your bare hands
- **Deliberate speed** - Mining takes **15 seconds**, making it a significant but achievable task
- **Works everywhere** - Break bedrock in the Overworld, Nether, or End

### 🔧 Compatibility
- **Flat Bedrock support** - Works seamlessly with the Flat Bedrock mod for those who prefer a smooth underground
- **No new blocks** - Pure vanilla behavior modification
- **Lightweight** - Minimal impact on game performance

---

## 🎯 Perfect For

- **Nether roof exploration** - Finally break through that ceiling
- **Underground building** - Shape the world as you see fit
- **Technical players** - Create custom mob farms and contraptions
- **Adventure maps** - Give players the ability to modify the world's foundation

---

## 💡 How It Works

The mod uses Forge events to modify bedrock properties:
1. Changes destroy time from infinite to **15 seconds** (5x longer than stone)
2. Removes tool requirement - any tool or hand works
3. Handles block break events to ensure smooth mining experience
4. Compatible with other mods that affect bedrock behavior

---

## 📝 Notes

- This mod does not add any new blocks or items to the game
- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer
- Completely reversible - just remove the mod to restore bedrock behavior
- The mod name "Fake Bedrock" reflects that it's now just a "fake" unbreakable block
- Mining time is intentionally set to 15 seconds to balance the ability to break the strongest block in the game
